title: A Join Avenue shop's land data patch: res/field/land_patches/<n>.json
description: File n of ARCID_LAND_DATA_PATCH (a/1/5/4), which a Join Avenue shop's column 6 names for the occupants at odd places and its column 7 for those at even places (ResortShopData_GetShopParam in resort_mapcreate.c): the tiles that LandDataPatch_OverwriteAttr writes over the avenue's terrain where the shop stands, six tiles wide and as many rows as fit in the chunk, and the props that LoadLandDataPatchBuildings adds there (land_data_patch.c). tools/data/land_patch_data.py packs them in order.

tiles.description: The patch's tiles, row by row from north to south, each row from west to east (LandPatchGrid)

items.description: A tile of an RD chunk's terrain (RDTile in field_map_chunk_rd.c): its two planes, cut along a diagonal, and its type

normal0.description: The normal of plane 0, the half nearer the origin, or the half with x > z

offset0.description: Plane 0's distance from the origin along its normal, in 4096ths of a unit

tile_type.description: The tile's type in hex, 31 bits: its flags (TILE_FLAG_* in include/field/field_map.h, GetTileFlags) in the high bits and its class (TILE_CLASS_*, GetTileClass) in the low 16

diagonal.description: Whether the tile is cut along x = z rather than x + z = 16

position.description: Where the prop stands, in 4096ths of a unit, from where the shop stands: LoadLandDataPatchBuildings adds the shop's column, in tiles of 16 units, to x and takes its row from z, which FieldPropSystem_InstantiateFromInfo negates

rotation_y.description: Its turn around the Y axis, in 65536ths of a turn

model.description: Its model, by its ID in the area's props (FieldPropSystem_ConvResIDToIndex)

normal.description: A unit normal's x, y and z, in 4096ths
